tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Find pages on remodelyourvibe.com by keyword. Searches all services, service-by-city pages, service areas and remodeling articles, and returns each match's title, URL, section and a one-sentence summary. Use it first to locate the right page, then read that page with fetch_page.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Read the complete text of one remodelyourvibe.com page as Markdown, given its URL or path. Returns the page title, canonical URL and full content, including prices, process steps, permit notes and FAQs. Use it after search_site, or directly when you already know the address.
